title: 美妆AI革命：虚拟试妆与皮肤扫描，千亿市场如何重塑消费体验？
speaker: Lisa Mateo

segments.en: The beauty industry has been experiencing its own makeover as personalization virtual trillions and AI skin diagnostics become a part of the everyday shopping experience according to independent market research platform Wi-Fi talents.
segments.zh: 美妆行业正经历自身的变革，个性化、虚拟试妆和AI皮肤诊断已成为日常购物体验的一部分，据独立市场研究平台Wi-Fi Talents称。

segments.en: Global AI beauty and cosmetics market is projected to be worth more than $13 billion by 2030 beauty executives say the artificial intelligence transformation extends from a shift in consumer shopping habits.
segments.zh: 全球AI美妆市场预计到2030年价值将超过130亿美元，美妆高管表示，人工智能转型源于消费者购物习惯的转变。

segments.en: Mike Moreska is chief technology and transformation officer at all to beauty consumers are really jumping into AI they're using it more and more to not only discover but increasingly a shop and inform their decisions that they make.
segments.zh: Ulta Beauty首席技术与转型官Mike Moreska表示，消费者正积极拥抱AI，不仅用于发现产品，还越来越多地用于购物和决策参考。

segments.en: I feel excited about this in 2025 we saw really AI driven shopping jump 115% on all the dot com.
segments.zh: 对此我感到兴奋，2025年我们在Ulta.com上看到AI驱动的购物增长了115%。

segments.en: What kind of AI advancements are you doing on the consumer end? One area we're actually making great progress is for our online shopper and that's with our virtual trial and tool clam lab.
segments.zh: 你们在消费者端有哪些AI进展？我们取得重大进展的一个领域是在线购物者的虚拟试妆工具GLAMlab。

segments.en: All you have to do is simply upload a photo of yourself and you can see what these products look like right on you.
segments.zh: 只需上传一张自己的照片，就能看到这些产品在你身上的效果。

segments.en: All the shoppers get the tech treatment in stores with its beauty skin scan. It's a device that's the consumer can use to capture three quick scans of the face it then matches the consumer with the best complexion or skincare products for them.
segments.zh: Ulta的顾客在店内可体验科技护肤，通过Beauty Skin Scan设备快速扫描面部三次，然后为消费者匹配最适合的粉底或护肤产品。

segments.en: It's amazing because it works across all skin types and tones it last year we did over 180,000 scans per month.
segments.zh: 它适用于所有肤质和肤色，去年我们每月完成超过18万次扫描。
